ralle.settings.title: RALLE Settings
ralle.settings.about.description: A client-side Wynncraft chat and Raid LFG mod for the Kingdom of Foxes alliance.
ralle.settings.about.disabled-notice: All features are disabled by default. Enable only what you want to use.
ralle.settings.unavailable: Enable the required parent setting to use this control.
ralle.settings.subcategory.guild-ranks.d: Optional Fox rank titles in Wynncraft guild chat.
ralle.settings.subcategory.message-direc: Controls whether new messages appear from the bottom or the top.
ralle.settings.subcategory.horizontal-al: Controls whether chat text aligns to the left or right edge.
ralle.settings.subcategory.text-shadow.d: Controls the shadow rendered behind chat text.
Optional session-only history across server and world transitions.
ralle.settings.subcategory.screenshots.d: Transparent chat screenshot selection and feedback.
ralle.settings.subcategory.controls.desc: Configurable shortcuts for opening and operating Raid LFG.
ralle.settings.subcategory.interface.des: Global presentation used by RALLE-owned interface text.
ralle.settings.category.chat.description: Local chat layout and rendering options for any world or server.
ralle.settings.category.raid-lfg.descrip: Alliance Raid LFG access and local notifications.
ralle.settings.option.edit-chat-layout.d: Opens the HUD layout editor for moving, resizing, or restoring the single chat box.
ralle.settings.option.edit-huds.descript: runs /ralle hud to show every currently enabled hud element.
ralle.settings.option.hide-chat-scrollba: Hides Minecraft's scrollbar while chat is open. Mouse-wheel scrolling still works.
ralle.settings.option.remove-chat-system: Removes Minecraft's colored bars and icons from system-managed chat messages without reserving space for them. Message text and its interactions are unchanged.
ralle.settings.option.chat-timestamps.de: Shows the local receive time as [HH:mm:ss] on every rendered chat line, including wrapped continuations.
ralle.settings.option.internal-guild-ran: Replaces only the rank title before guild-chat messages with each member's current Fox rank. The instance-local cache refreshes on Wynncraft join and every 30 minutes.
ralle.settings.guild-ranks.refresh: Refresh the local guild-rank cache now
ralle.settings.guild-ranks.refresh-unava: Enable Internal Guild Ranks and connect to Wynncraft to refresh
ralle.settings.option.chat-screenshot-en: While chat is open, hold either Ctrl key and left-drag across messages to prepare a transparent chat image. Ctrl+C or double-click copies it.
ralle.settings.option.chat-screenshot-sn: Fits the on-screen selection to each selected line and crops the copied image to the widest selected text instead of the full chat box width.
ralle.settings.option.chat-selection-sou: Plays intrument feedback as the selected message count changes and after a chat image is copied successfully.
ralle.settings.option.chat-screenshot-sm: Animates screenshot selection height changes over 120 milliseconds instead of snapping immediately.
ralle.settings.option.compact-chat.descr: THIS DOES NOT WORK AT ALL ignore PLEASE
THIS MAYBE WORKS SOMETIMES ignore REGARDLESS
ralle.settings.option.persistent-chat-en: Keeps displayed chat when changing multiplayer servers or singleplayer worlds. History is kept only until Minecraft closes and may mix messages from different worlds without labels.
ralle.settings.option.persistent-chat-li: Sets the maximum number of logical messages and wrapped chat lines retained in memory. Lowering it removes the oldest entries immediately.
Chooses whether new messages appear from the bottom or the top.
ralle.settings.option.horizontal-alignme: Chooses whether chat text is aligned to the left or right edge.
ralle.settings.option.text-shadow.descri: Changes the chat text shadow size. Note: this is most noticeable if 'Chat Text Opacity' is set to 0%
ralle.settings.option.notification-sound: Plays sound feedback for Raid LFG notifications and confirmed party membership changes.
ralle.settings.option.new-party-notifica: Shows a compact HUD card when a new party becomes available to join.
ralle.settings.option.reopened-party-not: Shows a compact HUD card when a locked or unavailable party becomes joinable again.
ralle.settings.option.party-status-notif: Keeps your current party on the HUD (as a notification card) when it was created or joined outside the Raid LFG screen. Close the card to dismiss it.
ralle.settings.option.auto-pop-out-main-: After you create or join a party through Raid LFG, closes the screen and keeps that party on the HUD (as a notification card) until you leave, disband, or close the card.
ralle.settings.option.edit-notification-: Opens the HUD editor with the fixed-size Raid LFG notification anchor selected.
ralle.settings.option.raid-lfg-keybind.d: Opens Raid LFG with a configurable key. It defaults to Unbound; /ralle lfg is always available as a fallback.
ralle.settings.option.raid-lfg-join-keyb: Starts the three-second Join countdown for the newest visible joinable notification card.
ralle.settings.option.raid-lfg-close-key: Dismisses the newest visible Raid LFG notification without cancelling or leaving anything.
ralle.settings.option.raid-lfg-leave-dis: Leaves your current party, or arms a five-second second-press confirmation when you are host.
ralle.settings.option.raid-lfg-party-fil: Invites every synchronized non-host member to the Wynncraft party when your Raid LFG lobby is full.
ralle.settings.option.raid-lfg-ping-keyb: Pings the current party when you are its host.
ralle.settings.option.raid-lfg-create-ke: Hold this key and release top-row 1–6 to create Dailies, NOTG, NOL, TCC, TNA, or TWP.
ralle.settings.option.raid-lfg-kick-keyb: Hold this key and release top-row 2–4 to kick that synchronized roster slot in order of who joined.
ralle.settings.option.automatic-raid-req: Reopens Party Finder, selects the raid most recently detected from your own Ready Up prompt, and readies without showing the menus. Unbound by default and active only on Wynncraft.
ralle.settings.option.interface-font.des: Chooses Vanilla or Karla for RALLE interface body text and controls. Fox screen headers always use Karla.
key.ralle.raid-lfg-leave-disband: Leave or disband Raid LFG party
key.ralle.raid-lfg-lock: Lock or unlock Raid LFG party
ralle.chat-layout.free-move.description: Move and resize HUD elements one pixel at a time.
ralle.chat-layout.snap-grid.description: Magnetically snaps HUD element edges and centers to the screen grid.
ralle.chat-layout.alignment-guides.descr: Snaps to screen edges and centers and shows red alignment guides.
ralle.chat-layout.show-all.description: Previews every registered RALLE HUD element while editing.
ralle.chat-layout.show-grid.description: Shows the 10-pixel placement grid across the screen.
ralle.chat-layout.position-info.descript: Shows compact coordinates and dimensions inside the selected element.
ralle.chat-screenshot.copy-failed: RALLE could not copy the chat image: %s. The selection was kept; check clipboard access and try again.
